_register: Buttons, menu entries and step lists use the singular imperative as Catalan software does (Presta, Desa, Cancel·la, Escaneja el codi de barres); sentences are impersonal or passive where possible and avoid addressing the reader; where a direct address cannot be avoided use the formal « vostè » forms; no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Catalan angle quotes «text» with no space inside them (nested quotes use “ ” and then ‘ ’); no space before : ; ? ! (e.g. Prestat: «{{title}}»); the arrow → stays. Specific to Catalan: the interpunct of « l·l » must be kept (col·lecció, cancel·la, il·lustració; the character is U+00B7, never a full stop or a hyphen); elision and contraction with articles and prepositions (l', d', de + el = del, a + el = al, per + el = pel) must be written correctly, so avoid placing a {{placeholder}} straight after an article or a preposition that changes before a vowel (rephrase, e.g. « Alumne: {{name}} »); use the same apostrophe everywhere (the plain ' as in the English files).
_plural: Two forms, one and other, as in English ({{count}} {{count:plural; one:exemplar; other:exemplars;}}); nouns and adjectives also agree in gender, so avoid sentences where the gender of a placeholder's noun would be needed.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; never « còpia » (that is a duplicate or a backup).

record.note: Bibliographic record, as in Catalan library catalogues (« registre bibliogràfic »); « fitxa » is the older card-catalogue word and is not used.

patron.note: Usual word in Catalan libraries and in Koha; the neutral plural « usuaris » in menus and labels. Alternatives « lector » is also used but is kept for the barcode reader.

card.note: Short form « carnet » where the context is clear; « targeta » is not used for a library card.

return.note: The action: « Devolució » on the menu, « retornar » or « registrar la devolució » for the verb; « retorn » is also correct but « devolució » is the usual word in libraries.

renew.note: Extending the due date; used by Koha and by Catalan libraries.

due date.note: Short form of « data de devolució prevista »; « data de venciment » is not used.

overdue.note: « préstec endarrerit »; « amb retard » is acceptable in a sentence (« en retard » is Spanish-influenced, avoid it).

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; the verb is « reclamar ».

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (« signatura topogràfica » in full), as in Catalan libraries.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and signatura on the spine; « llom » is the spine of a book.

class.note: A school class such as « 3r B »; the school level of a class is a « curs ».

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

classification.note: The sorting scheme; Catalan libraries use the CDU (Classificació Decimal Universal), so name the scheme only if the English text does.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue, as the school librarians say; « expurgació » means weeding and is not used.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « desiderata » (plural « desiderates ») is the established word in Catalan libraries; « suggeriments de compra » is the plain alternative if a longer text allows it.

census.note: Registering the usuaris with their photo.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year (3r B becomes 4t B).

language pack.note: « idioma » is used for an interface language; « llengua » is not used here.

colour set.note: Written « color »; « paleta » for the interface palette.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; short form « lector » in labels (« escàner » means a document scanner and is not used); patrons are « usuaris », so « lector » does not clash.

student.note: Invariable in the plural « alumnes » for both genders; « estudiant » is not used for school pupils.

teacher.note: Gender-neutral form chosen so that no feminine/masculine pair is needed; « professor » or « mestre » only where the English text names a specific stage.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; the area as a whole is « Préstecs ».
